label: def:grobner-shirshov-basis
title: Gröbner basis of the distribution algebra
html:
Let G be a formal group over a field k of characteristic p > 0 with an ordered coordinate system x_1 < \dots < x_n. Let X = \{\delta_{x_j}^{p^r} : 1 \le j \le n,\ r \ge 0\} be the divided-power generators, graded by \deg \delta_{x_j}^{p^r} = p^r and ordered by \delta_{x_j}^{p^s} > \delta_{x_i}^{p^r} when j > i, or j = i and s > r. In the tensor algebra TX put

  f_\eta = \eta^p - F(\eta), \qquad
  g_{\eta, \zeta} = \eta\zeta - \zeta\eta - \tilde\pi(\eta, \zeta)
  \qquad (\eta > \zeta \in X),

where F(\eta) and \tilde\pi(\eta, \zeta) are the expressions of \eta^p and of the commutator \eta\zeta - \zeta\eta in the multiplicative basis of \mathrm{Dist}(G). A Gröbner basis of an ideal for a monomial ordering is a generating set whose leading monomials generate the ideal of leading monomials; equivalently, the monomials avoiding them form a basis of the quotient.

Reference: [leitner2006], Remark 2.3 and Proposition 2.4; [leitnerpawloski2004] for the unital setting.
